card.name: Verbs and links in place histories
card.fires_on: Mixed words in descriptive web prose, mostly history or geography: verbs like fallen, undergone, or into after 'transformed', and the middle of place names like Nicaea or Fillah. The negative side fires here.

modes.label: Change-of-state words
modes.description: Verbs or linking words describing a place or thing changing state or role.
modes.example: before being transformed<< into>> it's present capacity as a museum,

modes.label: Inside place names
modes.description: Middle pieces of rare place names such as Nicaea.

modes.label: Comparison and status words
modes.description: Words like brighter or a that come after a number or 'as'.
modes.example: appeared 30 times<< brighter>> than it does this year.
